title: Maintaining Drain Trap Seals to Stop Sewer Gas
description: A P-trap relies on a standing water barrier to block harmful sewer gases from entering living spaces. In rarely used fixtures or warm environments, this water seal can evaporate over time, breaking the protective liquid barrier. A professional practice for infrequently used drains—such as basement floor drains or guest bathroom sinks—is periodic flushing with clean water or installing an approved trap primer where appropriate. Keeping the trap filled ensures sewer gas stays confined to the DWV system, maintaining safe indoor air quality and preventing foul sewer odors from escaping into the building.
